cohort: 236 drug-dependent pregnant women and 228 low-risk pregnant women at a hospital in Coimbra, Portugal, between 2001 and 2014.
finding: Drug-dependent women had a significantly higher rate of vaginal delivery compared to low-risk women.
mod_finding: Drug dependency was associated with a lower rate of cesarean delivery, but this association was not related to the type of drug, route of administration, or substitution maintenance therapy.
